# Libraries

```{r}
# load libraries
library(FLCore)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)

theme_set(theme_bw(base_size = 16))
```

# Data preparation

```{r}
# load object from WGHANSA 2022
load(file.path("..","data","aneq.stk.RData")) # aneq.stk

# remove 2023

aneq.stk <- window(aneq.stk, end=2022)

# recruitment (1st January)
# change units

rec <- rec(aneq.stk)
rec <- rec*1e-6
units(rec) <- "1e9"

# ssb (from FLBiols because it is the same as used in FLBEIA)

aneq.biol <- as(aneq.stk, "FLBiol")
ssb <- ssb(aneq.biol)
# equivalently, (i.e. without fishing mortality)
# quantSums(stock.n(aneq.stk)*exp(-m(aneq.stk)*m.spwn(aneq.stk))*stock.wt(aneq.stk)*mat(aneq.stk))
ssb <- ssb/1000
units(ssb) <- "1000 t"

# create data frame

df <- data.frame(year=as.numeric(dimnames(aneq.stk)$year), 
                 rec=as.numeric(rec), 
                 ssb=as.numeric(ssb))

# create log variables

df <- df %>% 
  mutate(logr=log(rec),
         logssb=log(ssb),
         rat=rec/ssb, 
         lograt=log(rat))

dat <- read.csv(file.path("..","data","env_data.csv"), sep=",")

df <- left_join(df, dat)
df <- subset(df, select=-c(date)) # remove the date column (which is a character)
names(df)
```

# Hindcast for Ricker using FLSR

Ricker SR model to the whole time series using FLSR

```{r}
sr.rick <- FLSR(rec=rec, ssb=ssb)
model(sr.rick) <- "ricker"
sr.rick <- fmle(sr.rick)
summary(sr.rick)
plot(sr.rick)
```

## Remove years sequentially

Check how stable is the Ricker model when removing years sequentially:

```{r, echo=F, results=F}

# maximum number of years
k <- min(floor(nrow(df)/2), 15)

# last year

yr.last <- range(sr.rick)["maxyear"]

# initialise

out.retro <- NULL

# loop
for (i in 0:k){
  sr.aux <- window(sr.rick, end=yr.last-i)
  sr.aux <- fmle(sr.aux)
  out.retro <- rbind(out.retro,
             c( i, yr.last-i, sr.aux@details$convergence, 
                c(params(sr.aux)), 
                vcov(sr.aux)[1,1,1], vcov(sr.aux)[2,2,1],
                sd(residuals(sr.aux)))) 
}
out.retro <- as.data.frame(out.retro)
names(out.retro) <- c("i","maxyear","convergence","a","b","a.var","b.var","sigma")
```

Quick check for convergence:

```{r}
all(out.retro$convergence==0)
```

Plots:

```{r, echo=F}
p <- ggplot(out.retro, aes(maxyear, a))+
  geom_line()+
  geom_point()+
  geom_ribbon(aes(maxyear, ymin=a-2*sqrt(a.var), ymax=a+2*sqrt(a.var)), fill="grey", alpha=0.3)+
  # geom_hline(yintercept =0, lty=2)+
  xlab("Last year")
p

p <- ggplot(out.retro, aes(maxyear, b))+
  geom_line()+
  geom_point()+
  geom_ribbon(aes(maxyear, ymin=b-2*sqrt(b.var), ymax=b+2*sqrt(b.var)), fill="grey", alpha=0.3)+
  geom_hline(yintercept =0, lty=2)+
  xlab("Last year")
p

p <- ggplot(out.retro, aes(maxyear, sigma))+
  geom_line()+
  geom_point()+
  # geom_hline(yintercept =0, lty=2)+
  ylab(expression(sigma))+
  xlab("Last year")
p

p <- ggplot(out.retro, aes(a, b))+
  # geom_line()+
  geom_point()+
  geom_errorbar(aes(xmin=a-2*sqrt(a.var), xmax=a+2*sqrt(a.var),
                   ymin=b, ymax=b))+
  geom_errorbar(aes(xmin=a, xmax=a,
                   ymin=b-2*sqrt(b.var), ymax=b+2*sqrt(b.var)))
  
```

All models: 
```{r}
aux <- data.frame(ssb=seq(0, max(df$ssb), length=1000))
for (i in 1:nrow(out.retro)){
  aux <- cbind(aux, out.retro$a[i]*aux$ssb * exp(-out.retro$b[i]*aux$ssb))
}
aux <- as.data.frame(aux)
names(aux) <- c("ssb", paste0("m",out.retro$i))
aux2 <- pivot_longer(aux, cols=starts_with("m"))
aux2$name <- factor(aux2$name, levels=paste0("m",out.retro$i), ordered=T)

ggplot(aux2, aes(ssb, value, col=name))+
  geom_line()+
  geom_point(data=df, aes(ssb, rec), inherit.aes=F)+
  ylab("R")+xlab("SSB")

```

## Remove 1 year 

Check how stable is the Ricker model to one year removal:

```{r, echo=F, results=F}

# years
yrs <- seq(range(sr.rick)["minyear"],range(sr.rick)["maxyear"])

# initialise

out.1out <- NULL

# loop
for (i in 1:length(yrs)){
  sr.aux <- FLSR(rec=rec[,-i], ssb=ssb[,-i])
  model(sr.aux) <- "ricker"
  sr.aux <- fmle(sr.aux)
  out.1out <- rbind(out.1out,
             c( i, yr.last-i, sr.aux@details$convergence, 
                c(params(sr.aux)), 
                vcov(sr.aux)[1,1,1], vcov(sr.aux)[2,2,1], 
                sd(residuals(sr.aux)))) 
}
out.1out <- as.data.frame(out.1out)
names(out.1out) <- c("i","maxyear","convergence","a","b","a.var","b.var","sigma")
```

Quick check for convergence:

```{r}
all(out.1out$convergence==0)
```

Plots:

  # geom_hline(yintercept =0, lty=2)+
  xlab("Removed year")
p

p <- ggplot(out.1out, aes(maxyear, b))+

  geom_point()+
  geom_ribbon(aes(maxyear, ymin=b-2*sqrt(b.var), ymax=b+2*sqrt(b.var)), fill="grey", alpha=0.3)+
  geom_hline(yintercept =0, lty=2)+
  xlab("Removed year")
p

p <- ggplot(out.1out, aes(maxyear, sigma))+
  geom_line()+
  geom_point()+
  # geom_hline(yintercept =0, lty=2)+
  ylab(expression(sigma))+
  xlab("Removed year")
p

p <- ggplot(out.1out, aes(a, b))+
  # geom_line()+
  geom_point()+
  geom_errorbar(aes(xmin=a-2*sqrt(a.var), xmax=a+2*sqrt(a.var),

# Basic Ricker fitted as lm

```{r}
# all years:
m0.2022 <- lm(logr ~ offset(logssb) + ssb, data=df)
coef(m0.2022)

# given that there are no environmental data in 2022, the reference model is until 2021
m0 <- lm(logr ~ offset(logssb) + ssb, data=subset(df, year<2022)) 
# equivalently: 
# m0bis <- lm(lograt ~ ssb, data=df)

coef(m0)
summary(m0)
anova(m0)
confint(m0, level=0.95)

par(mfrow=c(2,2))
plot(m0)

```

## Remove years sequentially

Check how stable is the Ricker model when removing years sequentially:

```{r, echo=F, results=F}

# maximum number of years
k <- min(floor(nrow(df)/2), 15)

# last year

yr.last <- range(sr.rick)["maxyear"]

# initialise

out.retro.lm <- NULL

# loop
for (i in 0:k){
  aux <- lm(logr ~ offset(logssb) + ssb, data=subset(df, year<=yr.last-i))
  out.retro.lm <- rbind(out.retro.lm,
             c( i, yr.last-i, coef(aux)[1], exp(coef(aux)[1]), -coef(aux)[2],
                summary(aux)$coef[,2]^2, summary(aux)$coef[,4], 
                summary(aux)$sigma, summary(aux)$adj.r.squared))
}
out.retro.lm <- as.data.frame(out.retro.lm)
names(out.retro.lm) <- c("i","maxyear","loga","a","b",
                         "loga.var","b.var","a.pval", "b.pval","sigma","adj.rsq")

```

# Prediction skill

```{r}
# number of data points used in the model fit
n <- nrow(df) 

# number of years to be removed (15 at most), ensure we have at last half of the data for the model fit
k <- min(floor(n/2), 15) 

# loop

out.pred <- NULL 
for (i in 1:k){
  aux <- lm(logr ~ offset(logssb) + ssb, data=subset(df, year<=yr.last-i)) # adjust the function accordingly. it may need for arguments, e.g. family in case of glm/gam
  pred.dat <- expand.grid(ntrain=(n-i), h=1:i)
  pred.dat$obs <- df[(n-i+1):n, all.vars(formula(m0))[1], drop=T]
  pred.dat$fit.mod <- predict(aux, newdata=df[(n-i+1):n, ])
  # pred.dat$fit.naive <- mean(df[(n-i-2):(n-i), all.vars(formula(m0))[1], drop=T],
  #                            na.rm=T) # 3 years average prediction
  pred.dat$fit.naive <- mean(df[1:(n-i), all.vars(formula(m0))[1], drop=T],
                             na.rm=T) # average past series
  pred.dat$e.mod <- pred.dat$obs-pred.dat$fit.mod
  pred.dat$e.naive <- pred.dat$obs-pred.dat$fit.naive
  out.pred <- rbind(out.pred, pred.dat)
}
out.pred <- out.pred %>% 
  mutate(hclass= cut(h, breaks=c(0, 3, 6, 15)),
         hterm=cut(h, breaks=c(0, 3, 6, 15), labels=c("short (1-3)", "medium (4-6)","long (7-15)")))

# summarise by ntrain (nb years for training)

res.ntrain <- out.pred %>% 
  group_by(ntrain) %>% 
  summarise(n=n(),
            relmae=mean(abs(e.mod))/mean(abs(e.naive)) )
res.ntrain

p <- ggplot(res.ntrain, aes(ntrain, relmae))+
  geom_point(cex=2)+
  geom_line()+
  expand_limits(y=0)+
  geom_hline(yintercept=1, lty=2, col=2)+
  xlab("Nb years training dataset")+
  ylab(expression(rMAE=MAE[mod]/MAE[naive]))
print(p)

# summarise by h (prediction time horizon) 

res.h <- out.pred %>% 
  group_by(h) %>% 
  summarise(n=n(), 
            relmae=mean(abs(e.mod))/mean(abs(e.naive)))
res.h

print(paste("Simple average of MAE by h", mean(res.h$relmae)))
print(paste("Weighted average of MAE by h", weighted.mean(res.h$relmae, w=1/res.h$n)))

p <- ggplot(res.h, aes(h, relmae))+
  geom_point(cex=2)+
  geom_line()+
  expand_limits(y=0)+
  geom_hline(yintercept=1, col=2, lty=2)+
  geom_hline(yintercept=weighted.mean(res.h$relmae, w=1/res.h$n), col=2, lty=2)+
  scale_x_continuous(breaks=seq(1, 15))+
  xlab("Time horizon (years)")+
  ylab(expression(rMAE=MAE[mod]/MAE[naive]))
print(p)

# overall MAE (weighted)

aux <- out.pred %>% 
  group_by(h) %>% 
  mutate(n=n()) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  summarise(relmae=mean(e.mod) / mean(e.naive),
            relmae.wt=weighted.mean(e.mod, w=1/n) / weighted.mean(e.naive, w=1/n))

print(paste("Ratio of unweighted MAEs", aux$relmae))
print(paste("Ratio of weighted MAEs", aux$relmae.wt))

# summarise by hclass or hterm (grouped time horizons: short, medium, long)

res.hterm <- out.pred %>% 
  group_by(hterm) %>% 
  summarise(relmae=mean(abs(e.mod))/mean(abs(e.naive)) )

p <- ggplot(res.hterm, aes(hterm, relmae))+
  geom_bar(stat="identity", fill="grey")+
  expand_limits(y=0)+
  geom_hline(yintercept=1, lty=2, col=2)+
  xlab("Time horizon classes")+
  ylab(expression(rMAE=MAE[mod]/MAE[naive]))
print(p)

# save out results

saveRDS(out.pred, file=file.path("results","output_predskill_rick.rds"))
saveRDS(m0, file=file.path("results","model_predskill_rick.rds"))

```
